findings.title: [P1] Make registered-command masking cover the backtick fixture
findings.body: The new self-test always fails before scanning any site files. `maskRegisteredCommands` only accepts a registered name when it is inside a JSON-style double-quoted string, but the added `registered command` fixture supplies the registered command inside Markdown backticks. It therefore leaves `ap09` visible, `findViolations` reports a work-package label, and `assertNegativeFixtures()` throws on every invocation.

findings.title: [P2] Reject malformed typed identities rather than treating them as machine data
findings.body: The identity classifier accepts any lowercase prefix and any non-whitespace payload. For example, `{ "normalizedIdentity": "x:AP09.7" }` is classified as a machine leaf and bypasses the pre-existing work-package-label check, although it is not a validated typed identity. Restrict this to the actual identity grammar/types (and validate the payload structure) so malformed leaves remain subject to prose checks.

findings.title: [P2] Do not classify arbitrary “source …” labels as citations
findings.body: The citation-label pattern accepts any label beginning with `source` followed by a space or colon. Thus `[source: read the guide](https://github.com/datrab/kubeclaw/blob/<40-hex>/docs/review/guide.md)` is treated as machine provenance and bypasses the outside-site navigation rejection, despite being reader-facing navigation. Limit the exception to the exact approved source-citation labels/data/declaration forms.

findings.title: [P2] Continue checking bare pinned documentation URLs
findings.body: The old check rejected every pinned GitHub URL targeting `docs/` outside `docs/site`. The replacement only iterates Markdown link syntax, while `withoutExternalUrls` removes bare URLs from the prose scan. A bare/autolinked immutable URL to `docs/review/...` is therefore no longer rejected even though Markdown renderers expose it as reader navigation. Preserve validation for bare URLs or explicitly classify them fail-closed.

overall_explanation: The boundary checker cannot start because its new backtick command fixture contradicts its masking implementation. It also introduces fail-open classifications for malformed identity fields and reader-facing pinned documentation navigation.
